mnemonics.name: Mnemonics
mnemonics.published: All 24 English and 24 Japanese BIP 39 reference vectors, from entropy through words to seed; the pinned wordlist hash.
mnemonics.additional: Checksum failures, entropy sizes and Unicode normalization cases.
mnemonics.limits: Public examples only; passing vectors does not establish the safety of a recovery phrase or wallet.

hd-wallets.name: HD wallets
hd-wallets.published: All 17 BIP 32 derivation chains and 16 invalid extended keys; master keys from the 24 English BIP 39 vectors.
hd-wallets.additional: Public/private derivation agreement, hardened boundaries and parent-key recovery from a non-hardened child secret.
hd-wallets.limits: Key derivation and disclosure demonstrations; no payment-server security or wallet recovery audit.

segwit.name: SegWit
segwit.published: The two BIP 143 SIGHASH_ALL witness examples: transaction serialization, signing preimages and digests.
segwit.additional: Byte layout, transaction IDs, weight and virtual-size arithmetic, and rejection of unsupported signature-hash modes.
segwit.limits: Selected witness-v0 examples, not every signature-hash mode or full transaction validation.

addresses.name: Addresses
addresses.published: Every Bech32, Bech32m and SegWit address vector in BIPs 173 and 350, including invalid-case rejection stages.
addresses.additional: Checksum edits, witness-version and program-length boundaries, and encoding round trips.
addresses.limits: Encoding validity does not establish ownership, balance or a safe destination.

psbt.name: PSBT
psbt.published: All 20 invalid and 10 valid BIP 174 PSBTs and its published role trace, through combination and extraction.
psbt.additional: Unknown-field preservation, combination order, rejection of different transactions, and fee arithmetic in the figures.
psbt.limits: A replay of the supplied PSBT v0 workflow; no live signing or complete signer-policy validation.

schnorr.name: Schnorr
schnorr.published: All 19 BIP 340 CSV vectors, with verification results cross-checked against noble; test-only signing reproduces vectors that supply secrets.
schnorr.additional: Curve and scalar boundaries, input lengths, changed messages and tagged hashes.
schnorr.limits: Verification demonstrations do not audit a signer’s randomness or nonce handling.

taproot.name: Taproot
taproot.published: All seven BIP 341 scriptPubKey cases and seven key-path inputs: tree hashes, tweaks, keys, control blocks, signature messages and signatures.
taproot.additional: Changed leaves, control-block parity and length, sibling ordering, and signature-hash boundaries.
taproot.limits: Wallet construction and key-path checks; arbitrary script execution belongs to the separately scoped Tapscript recorder.

tapscript.name: Tapscript
tapscript.published: Success and failure witnesses for six pinned Bitcoin Core script-assets cases, replayed through reviewed opcode traces.
tapscript.additional: Commitment failures, signature budgets, changed transactions, OP_SUCCESS decoding and unsupported-scope rejection.
tapscript.limits: A narrow trace recorder. The optional full Core-file sweep is skipped unless that pinned file is supplied; arbitrary scripts are not covered.

p2sh.name: P2SH
p2sh.published: Three spends from BIPs 143 and 174: legacy 2-of-2, wrapped P2WPKH and wrapped P2WSH, replayed with signature checks.
p2sh.additional: Redeem-script mutations, push-only rules, signature order, witness-stack rules and sigop limits.
p2sh.limits: Reviewed script forms and signature-hash modes only; unsupported opcodes and witness forms raise scope errors.

timelocks.name: Timelocks
timelocks.published: All 51 one-input cases in the pinned Bitcoin Core locktime excerpt, plus field examples from BIPs 68, 143 and 174.
timelocks.additional: Synthetic height and MTP boundaries, sequence flags and units, opcode-check order and median computation.
timelocks.limits: Narrow opcode forms and supplied chain anchors; the site does not query the chain or establish live spendability.

version-bits.name: Version bits
version-bits.published: Parameters and recorded deployments from the pinned BIP 9 assignments table, cross-checked against BIPs 68 and 141; BIP 8 rules from its text.
version-bits.additional: Synthetic signalling periods exercise thresholds, timeout precedence, MUST_SIGNAL and minimum activation heights.
version-bits.limits: A rule simulation, not a replay of historical block headers or a live deployment monitor.

wallet-paths.name: Wallet paths
wallet-paths.published: BIP 44’s 16 example paths and BIPs 84 and 86 root, account, receiving and change-address vectors.
wallet-paths.additional: Invalid path conventions, derivation from account xpubs, and an explicitly illustrative account-discovery storyboard.
wallet-paths.limits: Derivation conventions and a discovery illustration; no chain scan or complete recovery of account funds.

descriptors.name: Descriptors
descriptors.published: BIP 380 checksum and key-expression cases, and BIPs 381–386 valid script expansions and invalid descriptors.
descriptors.additional: Checksum substitutions, key types, context rules, hardened derivation and script-size boundaries.
descriptors.limits: Supported descriptor forms only. Miniscript and later extensions are outside scope; valid but unsupported forms raise scope errors.

musig2.name: MuSig2
musig2.published: The eight BIP 327 JSON vector files, including error cases; aggregated signatures are checked with BIP 340 verification.
musig2.additional: Key-order and coefficient checks, and rejection of reuse after the model wipes a secret nonce.
musig2.limits: Public test sessions; no audit of a real signer’s nonce storage, randomness or coordination.

silent-payments.name: Silent payments
silent-payments.published: All 28 BIP 352 send-and-receive vector cases, including labelled outputs and input eligibility.
silent-payments.additional: Malformed addresses, compressed-key rules, scanning eligibility and output-search limits.
silent-payments.limits: Supplied transaction examples and labels; no continuous blockchain scanning or live wallet recovery.

block-filters.name: Block filters
block-filters.published: All ten BIP 158 testnet block filters and headers, rebuilt from blocks and supplied spent-output scripts; its Golomb-Rice examples and a SipHash reference vector.
block-filters.additional: Encoding round trips, duplicate removal, empty filters, included-item matches and non-member searches.
block-filters.limits: Spent-output scripts come from vectors. No BIP 157 peer exchange, chain validation or proof that a remote filter is complete.

v2-transport.name: v2 transport
v2-transport.published: All seven BIP 324 packet-encoding vectors: shared secrets, derived keys, framing and published ciphertext checks.
v2-transport.additional: Encryption/decryption round trips, changed ciphertext, associated-data failures and rekeying boundaries.
v2-transport.limits: Decoded peer X coordinates are supplied by the vectors; ElligatorSwift encoding and decoding are not implemented. No live peer handshake is tested.

message-signing.name: Message signing
message-signing.published: BIP 322 basic and generated vectors: message and virtual-transaction hashes, every simple and full signature case, and published error cases.
message-signing.additional: Reviewed interpreter rules, changed messages and addresses, commitment checks and unsupported spend shapes.
message-signing.limits: A partial verifier: committed scripts or spend shapes outside its reviewed set and proof-of-funds PSBTs can be inconclusive; earlier invalidity still takes precedence.
